title: Answer: intelligence is the competency of navigating any space toward better regions

statements.text: Intelligence is the degree of competency with which a system navigates any space, not only the 3D space of movement but also anatomical, transcriptional and physiological spaces, toward better regions while avoiding being trapped in local minima. Its degree is roughly proportional to the system's ability to deploy memory and prediction to escape local optima. Every intelligence is a collective intelligence, and every estimate of a system's intelligence depends on the observer making it.
statements.scope: the TAME paper (2022), Table 1, the section on its conceptual components and its conclusion

sources.quote: Intelligence is the degree of competency of navigating any space (not just the familiar 3D space of motility), including morphospace, transcriptional space, physiological space, etc., toward desirable regions, while avoiding being trapped in local minima.

sources.locator: section Specific Conceptual Components of the Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere Framework
sources.quote: The degree of intelligence, or sophistication, of an agent in any space is roughly proportional to its ability to deploy memory and prediction (information processing) in order to avoid local maxima.
Every intelligence is a collective intelligence
Estimates of intelligence of any system are observer-dependent
